name: skill_read
description: Load a skill: a written procedure for one kind of work, listed in the skills index with when to use it. Call it before starting work a skill covers, not after, and follow what it says. Call it again whenever its text is no longer in this conversation — compaction folds a skill away like any other turn — rather than working from memory of it.

name.description: The skill's name, as the skills index lists it.
